projects.name: DakotaAC
projects.title: DakotaAC
projects.summary: A Minecraft anti-cheat built to keep your server a fair place to play.
projects.overview: DakotaAC monitors player behavior and suspicious packets to help server owners detect unfair advantages. Combat, movement, world interactions, and exploit checks live in one configurable Java plugin.

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [1.2.16] - 2026-01-31

### Added
- Added `howl-greeting` command and greeting message event for The Lunar Pack.
- Added guild event logging (bans, channels, emojis, roles, messages, voice states).
- Added `bellyrub` command with GIF support and custom responses.
- Implemented sharding support and updated start script.

### Fixed
- Fixed stale interaction handling in `interactionCreate`.
- Fixed interaction defer errors in `bellyrub` and `fetch-e621`.

### Removed
- Removed unused dependencies from `package.json`.
- Removed sharding support and related configurations (after rollout adjustments).
- Removed `howl-greeting.js` and `greetingMessageCreate.js` from The Wolf Den.

release.title: Server Launcher Reborn v2.1 - Windows x64
release.body:
# Server Launcher Reborn v2.1 - Windows x64

The Reborn desktop edition brings the current C# launcher to this repository with a portable Windows distribution.

## Download

Download **Server-Launcher-Reborn-2.1.0-win-x64.zip**, extract it into a writable folder and open **Server Launcher.exe**. .NET is included; an installer and developer tools are not required.

## Included

- PaperMC, Fabric and native Bedrock server creation.
- Automatic matching Java preparation and enabled-content runtime checks.
- Global RAM sliders, Standard/Balance/Performance profiles and Balance defaults.
- Per-server plugins, mods, add-ons and world management.
- Live console and process monitoring, LAN/public address display, server rename/delete.
- Desktop notifications, fixed event sounds, optional close-to-tray and Windows startup.
- Embedded application icon, logo and event audio in the portable executable.

The workflow starts the published executable in verification mode, reads its embedded images and four event sounds, renders the custom controls, and creates the ZIP with a source/version manifest. SHA256SUMS.txt and distribution-verification.json accompany the archive.

## Before use

- This edition is for Windows x64. Native Bedrock additionally needs the Microsoft Visual C++ x64 runtime.
- Internet is needed for initial server/Java downloads. Minecraft servers and JDKs are not bundled.
- Keep your servers/, runtime/ and launcher.settings.json when updating.
- A public IP display does not configure port forwarding or a tunnel.
- Electron profiles are not automatically migrated; existing worlds can be copied and imported.

This is the stable Windows release built from `main`. Its GitHub tag is `v2.1`; executable and package metadata use `2.1.0`. Older Electron releases remain available in the release archive.

projects.name: Skypixel
projects.title: Skypixel
projects.tagline: The place where it all connects.
projects.summary: The home of the Skypixel ecosystem. Every project, one place to explore.
projects.overview: Skypixel Framework is the presentation layer for this collection of projects. Built with Express, EJS, and vanilla JavaScript, it connects the portfolio to public GitHub repositories and releases.
projects.gettingStarted: Clone the repository, run npm install, copy .env.example to .env, and start the Express application with npm start. Use npm run build for hosted output or npm run build:static for a saved snapshot.

release.title: v1.1.12
release.body:
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [1.1.12] - 2026-02-06

### Added
- Dynamic projects list fetched from GitHub repositories.
- GitHub social preview images for project cards and popups.
- Automatic team listing from GitHub contributors (creator + contributors).
- Contributor profile buttons linking to GitHub profiles.
- Display names and bios pulled from GitHub profiles.

### Fixed
- Resolved GitHub API rate-limit fallback by parsing repository HTML.
- Improved popup data binding for project details.
- Smoother button hover transitions.

### Removed
- Static project cards and hardcoded team members.
- Team details popup in About page.
